A cut would make a 3-verse frame row (dateline, word-event, refusal) and open 20:4-26 on a question; the strategy's licensed internal seams of the history disputation are 20:27, 20:30, 20:39 only, all 'therefore … thus says' after a refrain, and the row already applies them. The row's own rationale already discloses the 20:3 oath and signature as paragraph-internal; it gains the rejected (c) cut as a named alternative.

rulings.decision: CONFIRMED: the routing meets E-18, with three conditions. E-18 requires that a corpus-wide order's predicate be evaluated by ONE sweep over the whole corpus, that its items travel with the CWO id and the narrowed-predicate label, and that coverage be proven by a sweep, never by per-row assertion. The builder evaluates every routed predicate corpus-wide from deterministic sources (CWO-EZ-06 over every tags entry of every row; CWO-EZ-07 from ngram7's offending_7grams; CWO-EZ-08 from check_register's 189 flags; the sweep residuals from the four manifests), stamps each item with its CWO id, and the coverage tool re-evaluates each predicate as its own sweep over the applied rows with the label verbatim and a COVERED/NOT_COVERED verdict. What E-18 forbids — a CWO dissolved into per-row judgement with no corpus-wide check — does not happen. The rewrites themselves (tags vocabulary, boilerplate, register) need an author's judgement and cannot be a sweep; per-part execution is the only way to do them blind to primaries. CONDITIONS: (1) the eight coverage reports are a gate: primaries do not launch while any of CWO-EZ-01, -02, -04, -05, -06, -07, -08, -09 reads NOT_COVERED on its narrowed predicate; (2) a CWO left NOT_COVERED after the wave gets ONE dedicated follow-up execution for that CWO across all parts (a true CWO execution), never a second per-part loop; (3) each coverage report records the execution ids of the author executions that carried its items, so the E-18 chain from order to sweep is traceable. Baseline residuals (72/87/2/3/204/3/189/2) are the pre-wave numbers and must fall to 0.
